availability.measurement: One hourly observation is good only when the public homepage, health, room create/join, two-player WebSocket-compatible playing state, and cleanup journey all pass.

good_conditions: room creation returns a valid waiting room
room join returns the exact connection contract
two unique WebSocket players receive joined and playing state
room cleanup is observed after disconnect
journey.failure_output: Aggregate stage identifier and bounded failure code only; no room IDs, player names, addresses, tokens, URLs, response bodies, or request IDs.

diagnostics.purpose: Private native metrics diagnose latency, saturation, and lifecycle behavior; they do not calculate public availability or replace external SLO evidence.
